purpose: User-requested deployment comparison after closing the categorical study. Inference only.
items: 10 shuffled three-hop development permutations, 5 V3 ID and 5 V3 OOD development problems (one per family per split), chosen by lowest salted item hash within each stratum.
decode: unrestricted vocabulary, batch-one greedy, identical tokenized chat prompt, fresh cache per request
order: Interleave one pointer with one procedural item. Base first for the first 10 paired questions and recurrent first for the second 10. One unscored one-token warmup per model load.
scoring: Numeric final answer in visible assistant content after closing the thinking segment. Incomplete thinking receives no answer credit. Separately report truncation, valid answers, output tokens and latency.
budget: At most 40 scored requests, 15,360 generated tokens. No training, architecture promotion or sealed items. A failure to produce answers is an operating-point result.
stop: Publish once both arms finish all 20 items. This descriptive iteration unlocks no additional experiments.
